title: Ep 31 — OpenAI's Chief Scientist Admits Nobody's Solved Alignment, and the Job-Matching App Built for Candidates Instead of Recruiters
description: A quiet 48 hours for AI releases gave way to OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki's essay calling for mandatory third-party safety audits, plus resolved threads on Windsurf/Devin Desktop and the Cursor model cutoff. Then a deep dive into Jobric, Erik Chavez's candidate-first AI job-matching tool reporting $3,300 MRR, and why the UK sports-venue EV charging gap just hit fourteen episodes with no movement.
